This interaction applies only to oral forms of both agents. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. GLP-1 agonists delay gastric emptying, which may affect the absorption of concurrently administered oral medications. Oral contraceptives should be taken at least 1 hour before or 11 hours after lixisenatide administration. 7.
